book_title: A Realistic Path To Peace: How to Stop the New Cold War and Prevent Nuclear Disaster
author: Dee Charles Knight
book_description: The world is in a crisis now. The danger of nuclear disaster and global war is greater than ever. The main reason is not China or Russia. It's the determination of "neocons" in Washington, DC, to maintain U.S. global domination regardless of what it might take. The stakes are high for them. They think if they "allow" any other country to challenge their global leadership, their whole system could fall apart. This mania is causing economic hardship in Europe and across the globe. The "justification" for all this is based on lies. A gigantic peace movement is needed to stop the war makers.Sanctions are severely damaging the economies of western Europe and other countries, including the USA. China does not threaten the U.S., and attacks against it by the U.S. government and mainstream media are false and counterproductive.A recent Pentagon assessment finds "tough realities" facing U.S. neocon war planners in Washington, as war supplies run short and cracks appear in the "unity" of the NATO alliance. The leaked assessment acknowledges "bleak prospects" on the battlefield in Ukraine. There is frank talk of a "Plan B" from "Foreign Affairs," the mouthpiece of the elite Council on Foreign Relations. They propose a "Korea solution" -- a long-term armed truce. I explain why this would not work, and describe more viable alternatives proposed by Lula of Brazil and Xi of China, with support from many countries in the Global South. I finish by discussing the crucial role of ordinary people in Europe, the US and the rest of the world.Show more
